description: This file is a shell script that sets up and runs various tests related to Git and Perforce (p4) integration, specifically focusing on RCS keyword handling, file scrubbing, and version control behaviors.

methods.name: write_scrub_scripts
methods.description: Creates Python scripts for RCS keyword scrubbing.

methods.name: scrub_k_check
methods.description: Checks that the RCS keywords in a file are correctly scrubbed.

methods.name: scrub_ko_check
methods.description: Checks that specific files with +ko keyword files are scrubbed correctly.

methods.name: create_kw_file
methods.description: Creates a C source file with RCS keyword lines for testing.

methods.name: p4_append_to_file
methods.description: Appends a line with current date to a specified file, after opening it for edit in p4.
